I'd make hand-fabricated street signs for places that don't exist, and I'd sneak them into real cities at night.

Not cutesy "Diagon Alley" signs — I mean exact, perfect replicas of municipal street signage. Same aluminum, same retroreflective sheeting, same Helvetica Condensed Bold, same bolt patterns. I'd study the specs for each city's department of transportation so they'd be indistinguishable from the real thing. The art wouldn't be the signs
